result:
I’d make empathy a prerequisite for power. Anyone with greater authority—political, economic, or social—would have to genuinely understand how their decisions affect those with less power.

Most cruelty thrives on distance: we abstract away the people we harm. If leaders, corporations, and institutions were required to see the consequences of their choices through the eyes of the people living them, the world would still be imperfect—but noticeably less indifferent.
